design_detail: European Citizens' Initiative "Tax the Rich" for a tax on large fortunes

design_detail: Regional surcharge to keep the wealth tax if the State abolishes it; harmonise regional powers

design_detail: 2024 Galicia programme proposes ending the wealth-tax rebate, lowering the exemption to EUR 300,000 excluding the primary home and increasing progressivity.
quote_original: Imposto de patrimonio: suprimiremos a bonificación da cota íntegra
quote_en: Wealth tax: we will abolish the full-liability rebate.
source_title: A Galiza que queres: programa de goberno 2024
grading_note: The party’s election programme sets out a specific reform of the existing wealth tax.

design_detail: Calls for a substantial reform of the wealth tax to increase its effectiveness and review exemptions.
quote_original: Hay que hacer una reforma profunda del impuesto de patrimonio para dejar de ser una figura tributaria marginal.
quote_en: The wealth tax needs deep reform so that it ceases to be a marginal tax.
source_title: Ikusmiran 15: Análisis sobre fiscalidad de Hego Euskal Herria
grading_note: The report expressly identifies the section as LAB’s proposals and calls for a more effective existing wealth tax.

design_detail: Opposes the Gipuzkoa wealth-tax reform that exempted business holdings and reduced its progressivity.
quote_original: configura un impuesto menos equitativo, porque dejan de gravarse con generalidad todos los bienes que forman parte del patrimonio
quote_en: It creates a less equitable tax because assets that form part of wealth are no longer generally taxed.
source_title: LAB ve un retroceso la reforma del Impuesto sobre la Riqueza
grading_note: The news report directly quotes the union opposing a specific weakening of the existing wealth tax.

design_detail: Proposes a EUR 350,000 exemption, ending regional rebates and adding a temporary surcharge to the wealth tax.
quote_original: proposem fixar el mínim exempt a l’impost sobre el patrimoni en 350.000 euros i suprimir les bonificacions autonòmiques
quote_en: We propose setting the wealth-tax exemption at EUR 350,000 and abolishing regional rebates.
source_title: Propostes per la nova normalitat fiscal
grading_note: The author’s signed opinion article presents specific wealth-tax measures for the coalition.

design_detail: Coalition proposes reducing the exemption to EUR 350,000 and removing regional wealth-tax rebates.
quote_original: proposem fixar el mínim exempt a l’impost sobre el patrimoni en 350.000 euros i suprimir les bonificacions autonòmiques
quote_en: We propose setting the wealth-tax exemption at EUR 350,000 and abolishing regional rebates.
source_title: Propostes per la nova normalitat fiscal
grading_note: Signed article expressly presents the coalition’s own detailed wealth-tax proposal.

design_detail: Co-authored parliamentary question criticising the Galician wealth-tax rebate and challenging the regional government’s appeal against the national solidarity tax.
quote_original: Matilde Begoña Rodríguez Rumbo
quote_en: Matilde Begoña Rodríguez Rumbo
source_title: Pregunta 11/POC-009662 sobre o imposto de solidariedade
grading_note: Signed question describes the wealth-tax rebate as an unfair benefit to the richest and criticises the appeal against the solidarity tax.

design_detail: Co-authored parliamentary question criticising the Galician wealth-tax rebate and challenging the regional government’s appeal against the national solidarity tax.
quote_original: Gonzalo Caballero Míguez
quote_en: Gonzalo Caballero Míguez
source_title: Pregunta 11/POC-009662 sobre o imposto de solidariedade
grading_note: Signed question describes the wealth-tax rebate as an unfair benefit to the richest and criticises the appeal against the solidarity tax.

design_detail: Expressly supports taking Senate bill 622/000017 to restore the wealth tax into consideration; it was rejected.
quote_original: voy a posicionarme a favor de esta proposición de ley porque creo que fue un error suprimir este impuesto
quote_en: I will support this bill because I believe abolishing this tax was a mistake.
source_title: Diario de Sesiones del Senado, 21 de julio de 2010
grading_note: His own speech announces support for the named wealth-tax restoration bill.

design_detail: Supports Senate bill 622/000017 to restore the wealth tax and calls for an improved version or similar tax.
quote_original: Cuando se comparten los argumentos, prácticamente al cien por cien, con el compañero que propone esta iniciativa
quote_en: When one agrees almost completely with the arguments of the colleague proposing this initiative.
source_title: Diario de Sesiones del Senado, 21 de julio de 2010
grading_note: His own speech expressly supports the proposal under debate, the named bill to restore the wealth tax.

design_detail: Opposes the Andalusian government’s effective abolition of the wealth tax in a council debate.
quote_original: Lo que es regresivo, es aplicar en Andalucía la eliminación del Impuesto sobre Patrimonio
quote_en: What is regressive is eliminating the wealth tax in Andalusia.
source_title: Pleno ordinario, 21 de octubre de 2022, punto 4
grading_note: The council minutes identify the finance councillor immediately before her speech, which criticises abolition of the named wealth tax.

design_detail: Calls for ending tax benefits for large fortunes and challenges the 50% wealth-tax rebate in Galicia.
quote_original: por que se mantén a bonificación do 50 % no imposto de patrimonio
quote_en: Why is the 50% wealth-tax rebate being maintained?
source_title: O PSdeG denuncia a fenda social de Alfonso Rueda
grading_note: Her reported speech opposes the specific 50% wealth-tax rebate, in the context of calling for an end to benefits for large fortunes.

design_detail: Proposes raising wealth-tax rates on large fortunes.
quote_original: Propoñemos elevar a actual escala de gravame neste imposto, no imposto de patrimonio, para os grandes patrimonios
quote_en: We propose raising the current rate scale of the wealth tax for large fortunes.
source_title: Galician Parliament, plenary debate, 25 November 2013
grading_note: The official transcript directly attributes the proposal to Jorquera.

design_detail: Calls for restoration of the 2018 wealth-tax rates after their reduction.
quote_original: Paula Vázquez Verao
quote_en: Paula Vázquez Verao
source_title: Motion 58119, Galician Parliament
grading_note: Vázquez initiated and signed the motion, which explicitly calls for restoring the 2018 wealth-tax rates.

design_detail: Calls for restoration of the 2018 wealth-tax rates after their reduction.
quote_original: Luís Villares Naveira
quote_en: Luís Villares Naveira
source_title: Motion 58119, Galician Parliament
grading_note: Villares signed the motion as parliamentary group spokesperson; the motion explicitly calls for restoring the 2018 wealth-tax rates.

design_detail: Supports the bill to raise wealth-tax rates.
quote_original: polo tanto, imos apoiar esa iniciativa, está claro.
quote_en: Therefore, we will support that initiative, that is clear.
source_title: Galician Parliament, plenary debate, 19 November 2019
grading_note: The speaker explicitly supports the wealth-tax amendment immediately after identifying the bill; its content is discussed in the same debate.

design_detail: Proposes lowering the wealth-tax exemption to €400,000.
quote_original: sobre o imposto de patrimonio está baixar o mínimo exento a 400.000 euros
quote_en: On wealth tax, the proposal is to lower the tax-free threshold to 400,000 euros.
source_title: Galician Parliament, budget debate, 21 December 2020
grading_note: The parliamentary transcript attributes the proposal to Rodríguez Rumbo.

design_detail: Defends Spain’s wealth tax and the solidarity tax on large fortunes.
quote_original: la existencia del Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio sirve, entre otras cosas, para gravar la riqueza y mejorar la progresividad del sistema fiscal
quote_en: The existence of the wealth tax serves, among other things, to tax wealth and improve the progressivity of the tax system.
source_title: El Impuesto de Solidaridad de las Grandes Fortunas cubre los agujeros
grading_note: The author explicitly defends the existing wealth tax and criticises its practical elimination.

design_detail: Argues in a debate for the Zucman minimum tax, a 2% contribution based on very large fortunes.
quote_original: Su propuesta es que los privilegiados con un patrimonio superior a los 100 millones de dólares (84 millones de euros) contribuyan cada año con el 2% de su riqueza.
quote_en: His proposal is that people with wealth above 100 million dollars (84 million euros) contribute 2% of their wealth each year.
source_title: El debate: ¿Hay que establecer un impuesto especial a los ultrarricos?
grading_note: Missé writes the affirmative side of a debate and supports the specific Zucman proposal; the article also contains a separate opposing essay.

design_detail: Oxfam report proposes a 3% minimum based on net wealth above €50 million, accounting for existing income and wealth taxes.
quote_original: Incorporar dentro del IP un impuesto mínimo del 3 % para patrimonios netos por encima de los 50 millones de euros
quote_en: Incorporate into the wealth tax a minimum 3% tax for net fortunes above 50 million euros.
source_title: Un impuesto al patrimonio para el siglo XXI
grading_note: The report identifies Macías Aymar as its author and recommends the specified minimum tax; this is stronger direct authorship evidence for an existing actor.

design_detail: Calls for a permanent progressive tax on wealth, including a 10% rate for fortunes exceeding €100 million, in the context of Basque fiscal reform.
quote_original: proponemos convertirlo en un impuesto progresivo permanente sobre el capital y añadir un tipo testimonial del 10% para patrimonios que superen los 100 Millones de Euros
quote_en: We propose converting it into a permanent progressive tax on capital and adding a 10% rate for fortunes exceeding 100 million euros.
source_title: Hacia una Reforma Fiscal en Euskadi
grading_note: The signed article explicitly refers to the existing wealth tax and proposes a specific progressive rate and threshold.

design_detail: Supports acting on an expert committee proposal to reduce wealth-tax exemptions and harmonise the tax across autonomous communities.
quote_original: es recomendable una revisión que simplifique las estructuras del impuesto (de patrimonio), minorando reducciones y bonificaciones
quote_en: A revision simplifying the structures of the wealth tax, reducing exemptions and allowances, is advisable.
source_title: Las verdades del porquero
grading_note: The author quotes the 2017 expert committee recommendation and calls for legislation based on its conclusions; the proposal explicitly includes fewer wealth-tax deductions.

design_detail: Proposes removing Bizkaia’s wealth-tax shield that limits the tax payable.
quote_original: Proponemos la eliminación del escudo fiscal en el Impuesto de Patrimonio
quote_en: We propose eliminating the tax shield in the wealth tax.
source_title: Bizkaia General Assemblies, plenary session, 13 December 2022
grading_note: The official transcript attributes this specific proposal to Ilardia Olangua.

design_detail: Adopted the Bizkaia wealth-tax foral law with an €800,000 general exemption; the final text set the top rate at 2%.
quote_original: Las Juntas Generales de Bizkaia han aprobado hoy
quote_en: The General Assemblies of Bizkaia approved today.
source_title: Las Juntas Generales aprueban el Proyecto de Norma Foral del Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio
grading_note: The legislature’s own report explicitly records passage of the wealth-tax law; opposition members sought a higher top rate.

design_detail: Calls for removing the wealth-tax shield, lowering the general exemption to €600,000 and applying a top rate of 3.5% above €10 million.
quote_original: Proponemos que el mínimo exento se reduzca a 600.000 euros
quote_en: We propose that the tax-free threshold be reduced to 600,000 euros.
source_title: Ezker Anitza-IU presenta una propuesta fiscal de país
grading_note: The party’s own published policy specifies changes to the wealth tax; presenters are not individually inferred to support every measure.

design_detail: Calls for removing the wealth-tax shield and replacing the family-business exemption with a relief.
quote_original: cambiando la exención de empresas familiares por una bonificación, eliminando el escudo fiscal
quote_en: Replacing the family-business exemption with a relief and eliminating the tax shield.
source_title: Propuestas sobre el IRPF en Euskal Herria
grading_note: In a signed article the former inspector explicitly advocates these changes to the wealth tax.

design_detail: Adopted the 2012 foral law establishing the wealth and large fortunes tax, replacing the wealth tax.
quote_original: Las Juntas Generales de Gipuzkoa han aprobado hoy
quote_en: The General Assemblies of Gipuzkoa approved today.
source_title: Gipuzkoa aprueba el impuesto a los ricos con el apoyo de Bildu y los socialistas
grading_note: The opened report explicitly identifies the assembly’s passage of the named wealth-tax law.

design_detail: Praised the named Gipuzkoa wealth and large fortunes tax when adopted.
quote_original: moderno y eficaz
quote_en: Modern and effective.
source_title: Gipuzkoa aprueba el impuesto a los ricos con el apoyo de Bildu y los socialistas
grading_note: The report attributes these words directly to him in support of the specific IRGF law.

design_detail: Describes the specific proposed Gipuzkoa wealth and large fortunes tax as an advance.
quote_original: un avance en la nueva fiscalidad
quote_en: An advance in the new tax system.
source_title: Bildu y PSE amplían su entente fiscal
grading_note: The report attributes her positive assessment directly to the named proposed wealth-tax law.

design_detail: Endorses the specific Álava solidarity tax on net fortunes adopted in December 2023.
quote_original: aumenta la progresividad del sistema fiscal, bajo el principio de que quien más tiene, más debe aportar
quote_en: It increases the progressivity of the tax system, under the principle that those who have more should contribute more.
source_title: El Pleno de las Juntas de Álava aprueba el Impuesto Temporal de Solidaridad de las Grandes Fortunas
grading_note: The speaker expressly praises the named wealth-tax law in the recorded debate.

design_detail: Supports the adoption and eventual consolidation of Álava’s solidarity tax on net fortunes.
quote_original: abrir la puerta de entrada y posterior consolidación de este impuesto a los ricos en nuestro territorio, por justicia social
quote_en: Open the door to the introduction and subsequent consolidation of this tax on the rich in our territory, for social justice.
source_title: El Pleno de las Juntas de Álava aprueba el Impuesto Temporal de Solidaridad de las Grandes Fortunas
grading_note: The speaker expressly supports adoption of the identified wealth-tax law and its eventual consolidation.

design_detail: Defends the existing wealth tax in a debate on the large-fortunes tax.
quote_original: el PNV defiende el Impuesto de Patrimonio
quote_en: The PNV defends the wealth tax.
source_title: El Pleno de las Juntas de Álava aprueba el Impuesto Temporal de Solidaridad de las Grandes Fortunas
grading_note: The speaker directly states that his party defends the wealth tax; no individual vote is inferred.

design_detail: Calls for integrating the wealth and solidarity taxes into a stronger revenue-raising instrument.
quote_original: la situación permitía integrar ambos en un instrumento con mayor capacidad recaudatoria
quote_en: The situation made it possible to integrate both into an instrument with greater revenue-raising capacity.
source_title: Grandes fortunas, impuestos pequeños
grading_note: The author personally advocates a specific stronger treatment of the two named wealth taxes.

design_detail: Sponsored amendments to the Bizkaia solidarity tax, proposing a lower threshold and a 3.5% top rate.
quote_original: Eneritz de Madariaga Martin
quote_en: Eneritz de Madariaga Martin
source_title: Bizkaia draft solidarity wealth tax: amendments admitted
grading_note: Official amendments identify her as proposer; their text advocates taxing wealth above €3 million and specifies a rate scale.

design_detail: Sponsored an amendment to harmonise wealth-tax rates and apply a 3.5% top rate above approximately €11 million.
quote_original: Arantza Sarasola Lartategi
quote_en: Arantza Sarasola Lartategi
source_title: Bizkaia draft solidarity wealth tax: amendments reserved for the plenary
grading_note: The official publication identifies her as proposer and contains the proposed tax scale.

design_detail: Praises the adopted Gipuzkoa solidarity tax after her group negotiated a lower threshold for its top rate.
quote_original: va un poco más allá en la progresividad fiscal
quote_en: It goes a little further in tax progressivity.
source_title: Gipuzkoa aprueba el impuesto a las grandes fortunas con el apoyo de PNV, PSE y Podemos
grading_note: Her directly attributed remarks favour the specific adopted large-fortunes tax.

design_detail: Defends the complementary Gipuzkoa wealth and solidarity taxes in the adoption debate.
quote_original: mejoran la capacidad recaudatoria, y redistribuyen el sistema fiscal y el Estado del bienestar
quote_en: They improve revenue-raising capacity and redistribute through the tax system and the welfare state.
source_title: Gipuzkoa aprueba el impuesto a las grandes fortunas con el apoyo de PNV, PSE y Podemos
grading_note: The speaker praises the two identified wealth taxes in the debate on the solidarity tax.

design_detail: Defends the wealth tax together with Bizkaia’s proposed solidarity tax.
quote_original: compromiso extraordinario
quote_en: An extraordinary commitment.
source_title: Juntas de Bizkaia aprueban en Comisión aplicar el tipo más alto del Impuesto a Grandes Fortunas desde 14,5 millones
grading_note: The report attributes the positive assessment to him in the debate on the named tax and existing wealth tax.

design_detail: Calls for retaining wealth taxation and increasing its revenue potential, including by widening its base or rates.
quote_original: la equidad y la redistribución obligan a considerar al Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio
quote_en: Equity and redistribution require considering the wealth tax.
source_title: Reforma fiscal, equidad y progresividad
publisher: Anuario de la Facultad de Derecho de la Universidad Autónoma de Madrid
grading_note: The author’s 2019 academic article argues the wealth tax is indispensable and proposes reforms to raise its potential.

design_detail: Calls for restoring a national wealth tax with a €600,000 exemption excluding the primary residence.
quote_original: La reinstauración del Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio en toda España
quote_en: The reinstatement of the wealth tax throughout Spain.
source_title: La imposición sobre el patrimonio como instrumento para una distribución equitativa de la riqueza
grading_note: His 2011 report explicitly recommends restoring the tax and specifies an exemption; the foundation presented it on 21 January 2011.

design_detail: Opposes abolishing the wealth tax in Spanish regions, explicitly qualified by the economic circumstances at the time.
quote_original: no creo que en este momento España pueda permitirse la supresión del impuesto de patrimonio en ninguno de sus territorios
quote_en: I do not think Spain can currently afford to abolish the wealth tax in any of its territories.
source_title: Ana Pardo de Vera: Al rey emérito hay que obligarlo a volver
grading_note: The journalist personally opposes abolition of the named existing wealth tax; her view is time-qualified.

design_detail: Opposed abolition and called for reinstating Spain’s wealth tax in 2011.
quote_original: no es razonable suprimir el Impuesto sobre Patrimonio y al día siguiente congelar las pensiones
quote_en: It is not reasonable to abolish the wealth tax and freeze pensions the following day.
source_title: Borrell defiende recuperar el Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio
grading_note: His own words defend the named existing wealth tax; the report says he favoured restoring it.

design_detail: Calls for a reformed, strengthened wealth tax, including reconsidering the family-business exemption.
quote_original: defender la vigencia de un Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio (en adelante, IP) reforzado, reformado y real
quote_en: Defending the continued existence of a strengthened, reformed and real wealth tax
source_title: ¿Sólo es posible un IRPF dual?
grading_note: His signed chapter explicitly recommends strengthening and reforming the existing wealth tax.

design_detail: Opposed abolition of the Andalusian wealth tax in a televised debate.
quote_original: el profesor Montero se ha mostrado en contra de derogarlo
quote_en: Professor Montero has come out against repealing it.
source_title: Eliminar el impuesto de patrimonio, ¿a favor o en contra?
grading_note: The broadcaster explicitly attributes opposition to repeal of the named wealth tax to Montero; wording is a report, not a direct quotation.

design_detail: Defended the existing wealth tax before the Congress finance committee.
quote_original: Ustedes saben que yo defiendo el impuesto sobre el patrimonio
quote_en: You know that I defend the wealth tax.
source_title: Diario de Sesiones de la Comisión de Hacienda, núm. 64
grading_note: The minister explicitly defended the named wealth tax in her own words.

design_detail: Supports retaining wealth tax while raising the exemption with inflation and varying thresholds by territory.
quote_original: En cuanto al impuesto de patrimonio, soy partidario de mantenerlo, pero con cambios.
quote_en: As for the wealth tax, I favour keeping it, but with changes.
source_title: Jaume Menéndez: Gravar el inmobiliario es como cazar elefantes en un zoológico
grading_note: His interview supports retaining the existing tax and proposes specific changes to exemptions.

design_detail: Called for restoring a national wealth tax, with revenue distributed by the central government.
quote_original: José Antonio Monago, ha defendido este miércoles el impuesto de patrimonio
quote_en: José Antonio Monago defended the wealth tax on Wednesday.
source_title: Monago defiende el impuesto de patrimonio y exige a las grandes fortunas que den un paso al frente
grading_note: The report explicitly attributes support for restoring the wealth tax to Monago; the excerpt is reported speech.

design_detail: Explicitly defended the wealth tax in an interview.
quote_original: Yo soy un defensor del impuesto de patrimonio y del impuesto de sucesiones.
quote_en: I am a defender of the wealth tax and the inheritance tax.
source_title: Martín Seco: Después del sanchismo la izquierda va a quedar derruida
grading_note: His own interview explicitly supports the named wealth tax; inheritance tax alone would not qualify.

design_detail: 2% tax on individual wealth over EUR 5 million
quote_original: Estrella Galán (Head of list for Sumar, Spain, The Left)
source_title: Open Letter: Global Redistribution
grading_note: Signed open letter calling for a 2% tax on individual wealth over EUR 5 million and urging EU citizens to sign the European Wealth Tax ECI.
